entries.targetModel: Compose a Ccxt provider pack from independently declared connection, catalog, market-data, account-observation, order-observation, and optional controlled-effect leaves. Each leaf owns its exact input/result/error schema; the fixed UTA-facing descriptor carries scope, revisions, delivery, effects, resources, source and availability. Account observations and order effects carry AccountScope; public catalog/market-data observations carry `dataContext: Public`; instrument/data/order leaves retain InstrumentId/NativeInstrumentKey and unit-qualified Decimal fields where applicable. entries.durability: PreparedPlanRecord is serializable data with scope, revisions, digest, native descriptors and FailurePolicy. JournalWriter atomically writes receipt/plan/dispatch/jobs and projections; SDK/client/cache never becomes durable identity.
preservedBehavior: Retain public/trading operation coverage, venue-specific overrides and all observed refusals at compatibility boundaries.
Retain legacy IBroker only as an edge projection, not as the new domain authority.
